title: Generate 30-second ads in a single Seedance 2.5 generation instead of stitching…
content:
Generate 30-second ads in a single Seedance 2.5 generation instead of stitching multiple 15-second clips to maintain consistency between cuts  
Use up to 50 reference inputs in one Seedance 2.5 pass to preserve consistency across the full clip  
Fix specific seconds of a Seedance 2.5 clip using timestamp-based editing instead of re-rolling the entire video
